tests.title: V2 customization specs round-trip
tests.description: Construct a v2 SoulDraftContent with identity theme/emoji plus persona, avatar, voice, and memory specs, serialize, parse, and assert nested fields survive.

tests.title: Customization content auto-marks v2 schema
tests.description: Serialize schema-less draft content with v2-only customization fields and assert the emitted JSON carries soulfactory-draft/v2 without mutating the original struct.

tests.title: V1 migration compatibility
tests.description: Parse no-schema legacy draft content and assert migration to latest preserves legacy fields while seeding nested avatar and voice specs.

tests.title: Customization fields affect spec hash
tests.description: Hash a v2 draft with customization fields twice for stability, then mutate memory search config and assert the hash changes.

tests.title: Runtime params migrate v1 draft fields
tests.description: Build runtime provisioning params from a pure v1 draft and assert avatar_prompt, assets.avatar_ref, and assets.voice_ref are present in migrated nested v2 fields.

tests.title: Memory spec maps to OpenClaw memorySearch
tests.description: Map a Voyage session-aware memory spec with top_k, score threshold, reranking, auto-index, and retention metadata into portable and OpenClaw-native config shapes.

tests.title: Memory spec supports local ephemeral strategy
tests.description: Normalize llama-cpp/local provider aliases and off/ephemeral strategy into an OpenClaw memorySearch config with enabled=false.

tests.title: Memory spec validation rejects invalid fields
tests.description: Assert unsupported provider/strategy, out-of-range top_k, invalid score threshold, negative retention, and rerank_model without rerank are reported.

tests.title: Memory configure params serialize into runtime control envelope
tests.description: Build soulfactory.memory.configure params, embed them in a RuntimeControlEnvelope, and verify the kind:38384 JSON content preserves memory_config and OpenClaw memorySearch patch fields.

tests.title: Personality service maps specs to prompt sections
tests.description: Map a SoulPersonaSpec with traits, style, tone, constraints, and explicit sections, then assert normalized section content and deterministic composite prompt ordering.

tests.title: Persona update 38384 params contract
tests.description: Build soulfactory.persona.update params and embed them in a RuntimeControlEnvelope, asserting method, schema, OpenClaw prompt fields, OpenClaw-native agent defaults patch keys, and 38384 tags/content survive parsing.

tests.title: Persona validation rejects malformed fields
tests.description: Assert duplicate traits, unknown sections, excessive constraints, and disallowed control characters are rejected before runtime params are built.

tests.title: Prompt assembly omits empty sections
tests.description: Assemble a prompt from a partial section set and assert empty role/red_lines sections are omitted.
